checks.detail: Exact P5/p5-attempt-001/V3.4.2-P0R2 identity, approval, hashes, and immutable artifact references are bound.
Public verifier-before-closer sequence is mandatory, includes post-commit re-verification, and forbids private close APIs.
Later HEAD is restricted to an ancestral, single-parent, immutable JSON evidence-only suffix with source and test changes forbidden.
Publication requires an exact PASS receipt with empty findings, designated reviewer identity, and candidate-SHA binding.
Review-time Authority matches the active pre-review policy, has no grants, tickets, or pending outbox, keeps auto-advance disabled, and permits no forbidden activity.
